basics.name: Adam Bell
basics.summary: Information & Computer Science and Psychology graduate with a strong foundation in data pipelines, relational databases, and full-stack development. Experienced in Python scripting, server/database administration, and secure software practices. Proven ability to deliver across domains and team sizes — from financial modeling and security analytics to neuroscience research tooling — with a consistent focus on quality and collaboration.

valueProposition.title: Value Proposition — Data Analyst
body: Hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle — from designing PostgreSQL schemas and building Python enrichment pipelines to delivering financial forecasting dashboards for real clients.
I bring both the technical depth to work at the system level and the analytical mindset to communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Seeking a Data Analyst role where I can apply my skills in SQL, Python, data modeling, and visualization to help teams make better decisions with their data.

work.summary: IT-focused HR assistant supporting server infrastructure and HR platform administration.
highlights: Managed server and relational database backups, conversions, and ongoing maintenance, ensuring consistent data integrity across updated systems.
Co-developed a Python screening script to query, filter, and flag potentially harmful contracted individuals — a data pipeline automating a previously manual process.
Optimized server UI workflows to improve data entry accuracy and reduce manual error rates.
Administered employee permissions and access controls within the NEOED HR platform, enforcing role-based data security policies.

volunteer.summary: Assisted patients and staff in the ICU with a wide range of tasks in a fast-paced medical environment.
Supported the lead teacher by preparing supplies, guiding students through projects, and maintaining a positive classroom environment.

awards.title: Dean's List
awards.summary: Awarded to students who maintain a 3.5+ GPA.

projects.name: Makaʻala Shield
projects.summary: Modular security analysis platform (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React). Designed the full relational database schema, built the vulnerability enrichment pipeline against OSV/CVSS/KEV/EPSS enrichment APIs and catalogs, and integrated three open-source scanners into a unified, filterable dashboard — completed as a two-person team on a five-person scope.

projects.name: Kālā Forecast
projects.summary: Full-stack financial sustainability platform for Spire Financial (Meteor, MongoDB, React). Contributed database-driven forecast calculations, stress-testing models, scenario analysis views, and dynamic charting — delivering real financial tooling to our client.

projects.name: NeuroEcho
projects.summary: Cognitive neuroscience data collection toolkit for auditory ERP research (MATLAB, Python, PsychPortAudio, LSL). Led full-stack development as Technical Lead, delivering a precision-timed stimulus platform for lab settings — enabling brain-response data collection in populations that cannot participate in traditional cognitive tasks.

projects.name: Project Portal Hawaii
projects.summary: Collaborative web platform for University of Hawaiʻi students to discover and join faculty/sponsor projects. Designed and maintained the relational database schema and back-end APIs supporting user and project data.
